entities.name: Rémi Fraisse
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Rémi Fraisse was a French botanist involved in nature conservation. He was killed by the explosion of an OF-F1 grenade. The projectile was fired by an officer of the gendarmerie; his family later brought charges against him. Fraisse died at the age of 21 during protests against the construction of the Sivens Dam.
